hook: IdeaLens just shifted AI detection away from simple prose.

sections.voiceover: IdeaLens just shifted AI detection away from simple prose.

Nature reported on the 13th of October 2026 that a tool named IdeaLens identifies machine-generated concepts. Existing detectors like Pangram only scan language patterns. How does IdeaLens spot hidden AI?
Instead of text, it maps the underlying structure of scientific research papers.
Rishanth Rajendhran and Minjoon Choi built IdeaLens to map outlines. IdeaLens on October 13, 2026, exposed AI-generated concepts in papers.
Use IdeaLens to inspect scientific research papers today.
